root_idea.summary: A semantic orientation toward beauty, adornment, and luminous display.
root_idea.development: The lexical network links the illuminating سِرَاج to brightness and beauty, the سَرْج to an animal's adornment, and several derived uses to making a face or thing beautiful.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form سِرَاجٌ.

senses.definition: A light-giving source, especially the sun.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage, the term presents the sun as a lamp-like source of illumination.

senses.definition: An illuminating lamp, figuratively of a messenger.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic description of the Prophet as a light-giving or illuminating lamp.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie or fabricate a lie.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or allegedly figurative use in the cited lexical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Brightness or shining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An infinitival noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become beautiful or handsome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially said of the beauty of the face; the use is reported with differing judgments about its antiquity or acceptability.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make beautiful, adorn, decorate, or embellish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be applied to a face or to a thing; figuratively, it can mean to embellish or elucidate an affair or case.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accommodate, adapt, or dispose someone or something toward a right course or outcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension reported in the lexical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To forge a lie against someone or fabricate stories.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى in the sense of lying against someone and of forging or embellishing reports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To light a lamp or wick, or to use a lamp as a means of illumination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be the lamp itself; the extended construction can describe lighting oneself or another with it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To saddle an animal or horse, or to make a saddle for it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The saddle is bound upon the animal or horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manure land with dung.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized derived verb formed from سِرْجِين.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saddle or similar equipment belonging to a horse or other riding animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in a proverb for an affair or condition that has become disordered or unsound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Continuing or lasting, especially for a long time or forever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing continuance or permanence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foolish or stupid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dung used as manure, especially the dung of horses and other animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An arabicized loanword; the cited material also records the variant سِرْقِينٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Natural or innate disposition, nature, or manner of conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person's characteristic nature or of people sharing one uniform disposition; the related form سِرْجِيجَةٌ has the same meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lamp or its lighted wick; by extension, the lamp apparatus that contains or supports it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic sense is a lighted wick, while the name is also conventionally applied to the vessel or place associated with it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The eye, metaphorically likened to a lamp.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative comparison based on the eye's brightness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The craft or occupation of a saddler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The profession of making or dealing in saddles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A designation for certain swords, either named after a smith called Surayj or characterized by abundant water and glistening, wavy grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited material records both explanations of the designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saddler, maker or seller of saddles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person associated with making or selling سُرُوج.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great or habitual liar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe one who exaggerates or adds to his narration; also occurs in the expression سَرَّاجٌ مَرَّاجٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clear, white, and bright, especially of a forehead or side of the forehead.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective comparing the brightness to that of a lamp.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sesame oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An arabicized and reportedly vulgar form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lie.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An explicitly cross-referenced noun for a fabricated statement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Saddled; having a saddle bound upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a horse or other riding animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lamp or lamp vessel containing the wick and oil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited material distinguishes this function from the object supporting a lamp, while reporting disagreement over the vowel assignment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stand or support on which a lamp or its vessel is placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited material reports variant vowel assignments for the lamp-vessel and support senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made beautiful or well-formed; specifically, a face beautified by God or a nose fine and even in shape.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The nose usage compares its slender, even form to a particular kind of sword.

cautions: Modern Quran locations and examples follow the supplied QAC occurrences; historical Lane citation conventions are not converted into modern verse references.
The literal lamp sense is kept under broader Classical Arabic, while the Quranic entry distinguishes the sun's illuminating-source use from the figurative messenger use.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:srj:40842:g3:main reports a Form I hair-plaiting use, but the source itself suspects a transcription for سرّحت; the assignment is therefore left unresolved.
lane-unit:srj:40842:g4:main records an alleged Form I saddle meaning that the source says is not found in the cited lexicons; it is not treated as an established Form I meaning.
